title: A PR closes as replaced the moment the PR that replaces it opens
why: Old PRs left open until their replacement merged built a backlog the owner called "so massive" (owner, 21:27 CST Nov 9).
note: Owner ruling in chat, 21:27 CST Nov 9, relayed by the coordinator 21:30 CST: "u rly need to be closing old prs as soon as new ones that replace them come about else we end up how we are now which is so massive — i think before wed close prs only after the newer one merged but does that rly make sense". Scope: (1) rewrite in place the close-after-merge text (skill ci-hygiene step 8, "When the integration PR merges, each lane PR closes as replaced"; decision session-tiers, the line about replaced drafts) to: a PR closes as replaced when the PR that replaces it opens; its branch stays, and it reopens if the replacement is dropped. (2) Mechanize: the act that opens a replacing PR closes the PR it names, and the batch runner's wake closes any open PR that an open PR names as replaced. Meanwhile the coordinator closed #919, #1143, #1378, #1595, #1804, #1808, #1847, #1855, #1868 and #1931 (replacers open). Related: steps pr-backlog-clear and close-replaced-prs-1103 (one-off close lists). Owner chat 21:29 CST, relayed 21:33 CST: "i mean prs that are now stacked as another pr can still be considered closed and if the stacked pr fails then they reopen? unsure but ik for a fact the amt of open prs we have now is not best practices". Added scope: a PR carried in full by another open PR (its head is an ancestor of that PR's head) also closes, and reopens if the carrier is dropped. Fold (12:21 CST Nov 10, outbox sweep, owner pick 493 a): claude-settings outbox health-check-nov-9.md bullet 1 (761 open PRs). Also pr-backlog-clear. Lane prose-unmapped started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium). Consultant 20:04 CST Nov 13 (20:06; the consultant asked for slug close-replaced-on-open; triage folded it here, same ask, no duplicate). Owner 20:03 CST: "isnt that mechanicslly solvable too or it just needs good prose guidi g it", about closing a replaced PR as soon as its replacement exists (ruled R66, item 691 a; session-tiers line 78). Scope: the merge tool, the one home of PR acts, closes each PR that a PR body names as "Replaces #N", "Carries #N" or a combined-PR member list, with a pointer comment, at merge --ready and at every combined-PR hand-in; lane lint refuses a hand-in whose body names an open replaced PR. Cost: one REST close per named PR, only at those two acts; no workflow, no timer. Red case first: tonight #1636 stayed open behind #3210 and #3277 behind #3278. Mechanizes a ruled rule (outcomes-mechanize-rules): no owner question. Step has no lane yet.
